author: WP20
summary: A short roadmap of open evidence work (renderer capability truth, native platforms, content pipeline, C API gate, Diagnostics/Inspector, bindings) plus rules for the bug backlog and re-auditing. The status items were re-checked against TARGET and the site's detailed roadmap, which already carries them (the C API premise was corrected to the generated gate's single unmet criterion). The defect-ledger rules and the generic re-audit procedure are new on the project-records page; book-production steps are history.

sections.heading: Roadmap, Open Gaps, and How to Re-Audit This Book

concepts.section: Roadmap, Open Gaps, and How to Re-Audit This Book
concepts.text: TARGET has closed large alpha.1 plans (curated renderers, native platforms, complete API representation, the Content Pipeline/CNB system, a broad C ABI, Diagnostics/Inspector), so remaining work is evidence and operation-level depth.
tokens: Remaining work is therefore depth, not breadth

concepts.section: Close capability truth across the current renderer set
concepts.text: Open renderer work: operation-level capability truth (formats, MSAA/MRT, state, recovery, effects), deterministic answers for intentionally bounded families, and physical Windows/macOS and real-browser evidence kept separate from translated or headless runs.
concepts.note: The Bible's own recommendation wording is not copied; the site's roadmap rows carry the TARGET status.

target.evidence: docs/roadmap.html#remaining rows (SupportsCapability, surface formats, Direct3D manual lanes, Metal needs a Mac)

concepts.text: Open platform work: native Win32 lacks IME composition, gamepad and drag-and-drop support, and Wayland has no CI lane; wider X11/Wayland desktop evidence is outstanding.
tokens: lacks gamepad, IME and drag-and-drop support

target.evidence: modules/platform/src/Win32/Win32Platform.cpp (no ImmGetContext/WM_IME_COMPOSITION, XInputGetState, WM_DROPFILES, WM_INPUT, GetDpiForWindow); .github/workflows (no Wayland job)

concepts.text: Content Pipeline interoperability should extend only where real assets demand it, and CNJ still lacks the size/depth limits and fuzzing the XNB and CNB paths have.
tokens: CNJ has no document-size or nesting limit

concepts.section: Repair the current C API release gate
concepts.text: The C ABI 0.29.0 must not be called coverage-closed: the generated release gate reads Not ready with one unmet criterion, 468 public C++ symbols unmapped.
tokens: 468 public C++ symbols are still unmapped
concepts.note: The Bible's repair steps (classifying design/diagnostics/inspector modules, a failing freshness check) are not established at TARGET: the limitations-matrix criterion reports current.

target.evidence: docs/c-api/RELEASE_GATE.md (Verdict: Not ready, 1 criterion unmet; limitations criterion met)

concepts.text: Diagnostics and Inspector need representative-host benchmarks, overflow and shutdown stress, and consumer security tests while Inspector stays observational and opt-in; no CI workflow configures either module.
The C ABI is a foundation, not proof, for bindings: each needs version negotiation, ownership and callback tests, packages and platform consumers, and bindings are pinned to ABI 0.21.x.
tokens: Language bindings are separate projects pinned to ABI 0.21.x

target.evidence: site canonical facts (bindings target 0.21.x; CNA exports 0.29.0)

concepts.text: A defect ID stays open until source plus a regression or reproducer proves it fixed or its contract is gone; partial fixes narrow the entry, new IDs go above the maximum, and gaps or missing evidence are not defects.
tokens: new identifiers above the current maximum
functional gap, platform limitation, verification gap

target.evidence: methodology; mirrored by GltfKnownDefectTests.cpp ledger test

concepts.text: Re-audit documentation from the pinned commit to the new head read-only: inventory campaigns and changed paths, re-derive registry facts from source, carry every defect ID forward, scan for removed functionality and keep the previous published state intact.
tokens: re-derive every registry-backed fact from source

concepts.text: Book-edition specific re-audit steps: update LaTeX, render and verify changed PDF pages, rebuild HTML and keep the sealed previous edition.
concepts.note: These steps belong to producing the reference book, not to CNA or to this site; the generic procedure is kept on the project-records page.
